meta.title: About Tavio
meta.description: Tavio is a simple, modern alternative to heavy ERPs, built for Algerian shops, in French and Arabic.

about.title: A *modern* alternative to heavy ERPs, built for Algeria
about.body: Classic ERPs are heavy, expensive and built for large companies. Tavio brings credit sales, customers, invoicing and stock into one app, in French and Arabic.

items.title: French and Arabic
items.body: The app and its documents work in both languages, for the whole team, from the owner to the salesperson.

items.title: Simple and fast
items.body: A clear interface that runs well on an entry-level phone, even on a modest connection.

items.title: Fair prices in dinars
items.body: Indicative prices in DZD, per user, detailed on the Pricing page.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.body: Your data stays in the Tavio cloud, hosted in the European Union, or on your own servers.

meta.title: Tavio frequently asked questions
meta.description: Languages, credit sales, prices in dinars, data, the On-premise offer and the AI assistant: the essential answers.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Answers to the questions shop owners ask us most often.

items.question: Does Tavio work in Arabic and French?
items.answer: Yes. The interface and documents are available in French, Arabic and English. Each user picks their language.

items.question: Can I manage credit sales and instalments?
items.answer: Yes. You create an instalment plan, track every due date and follow up with customers who are late.

items.question: Does Tavio work on a phone?
items.answer: Yes. The app is built for entry-level phones as well as computers.

items.question: Can I turn on only some modules?
items.answer: Yes. You choose the modules your business needs. They share the same customers, products and invoices.

items.question: Are prices in dinars?
items.answer: Yes. Prices are shown in DZD, per user, as indicative prices. The details are on the Pricing page.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: You can pay by CCP, bank transfer or cash. The exact terms are confirmed when you subscribe.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: The subscription term and cancellation conditions are set out in our Terms of use.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: In the Tavio cloud, hosted in the European Union (Paris), or on your own servers with the On-premise offer.

items.question: Is my data protected by law?
items.answer: We process personal data in line with Algerian Law 18-07. Our privacy policy sets out these commitments.

items.question: Who can access my data?
items.answer: You decide who can access your workspace, with roles and permissions for each user. Your data is not sold to third parties.

items.question: What is the On-premise offer?
items.answer: Tavio installed on your own servers, with Docker, so your data stays in Algeria.

items.question: Who handles backups?
items.answer: You manage backups on your infrastructure, following the documented procedure. Our support helps you set up restores.

items.question: Which AI does Tavio use?
items.answer: The AI helpers are optional and work with the provider of your choice.

items.question: Does my data go to the AI provider?
items.answer: Only the information you send to the assistant is passed to the provider you chose. You can turn these features off.

items.question: Can I use Tavio without AI?
items.answer: Yes. All management features work without the AI assistant.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: Data we collect, why, where it is stored and your rights under Algerian Law 18-07 on personal data.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.review: To be reviewed by a lawyer before publication.

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is [company name to be completed], [NIF to be completed], [RC to be completed], [address to be completed]. Contact: [email to be completed].

sections.title: Data we collect
body: Contact form: name, company, phone, email, wilaya and the content of your message.
App: account details, your company details and the data you enter (customers, products, sales, invoices).

sections.title: Purposes
body: To answer your requests, provide the service, issue and track your invoices, keep the platform secure and improve the product using aggregated statistics.

sections.title: Where data is stored
body: By default, data is hosted in the Tavio cloud, in the European Union (Paris). Customers who prefer can host their data in Algeria, on their own servers (On-premise offer).

sections.title: Retention
body: Data is kept for the duration of your subscription, then as long as legal obligations require. Contact requests are kept only as long as needed to answer them.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under Law 18-07, you can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, and object to certain processing. Send your request to the contact address above.

sections.title: Processors
body: We use technical providers (hosting, email delivery). They process data only for our needs and on our instructions.

sections.title: Purpose

sections.title: Account and access
body: You are responsible for keeping your login details confidential and for actions taken from your account. You must give accurate information when you sign up.

sections.title: Subscription and payment
body: Subscriptions are billed in Algerian dinars (DZD), per user, according to the plan you choose. Prices shown are indicative and may change with prior notice.

sections.title: Your data
body: You remain the owner of the data you enter and are responsible for its accuracy and lawfulness. Personal data processing is described in our privacy policy.

sections.title: Service availability
body: We work to keep the platform available, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted operation. Maintenance is announced in advance where possible.

sections.title: Cancellation
body: You can cancel your subscription at any time under the terms that apply to your plan. We may suspend an account used in breach of the law or of these terms.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by Algerian law. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of [city to be completed].
